tools.name: apprentice_minimum_wage
tools.description: The legal minimum pay for an apprentice in the UK (gov.uk rates): hourly, weekly, monthly and yearly, gross, for the hours given. Uses an age band only, never a date of birth.

tools.name: get_larkforth
tools.description: Describes Larkforth, a web app that helps 16 to 18 year olds in England find apprenticeships and degree apprenticeships and write their applications in their own words, with a parent or carer view. Gives the free plan, the 6-month pass price, free resources for parents and the sign-up link.
